podcast.body: Released between 2001 and 2004, this album achieved commercial success, going gold or platinum in Canada, the US, the UK, and Japan. "Some 41 with Does This Look Infected and Chuck, all between 2001 and 2004, all went gold or platinum in Canada, the US, the UK, and Japan."

podcast.body: Released on November 26, 2002, this album was created under extreme time pressure, with the band having only six weeks off between tours to write and record. Recording continued even while the band was touring Europe, with sessions at Lipic Studios in London after playing festivals like Reading and Leeds. The gross album cover image was decided before the title, and the title itself was chosen at the last minute by the band members looking at the cover. "Does This Look Infected was a funny record for us because we didn't give ourselves any time to make a new record coming to try to follow up from all killer."
